items.raw_excerpt: When visiting Águeda, I was mainly looking forward to seeing its famous umbrella-covered streets. However, before we even reached the town centre, we started noticing beautiful flower decorations covering the fronts of several buildings.
items.summary_en: The town of Agueda in Portugal is famous for its streets covered with colourful umbrellas. Before you even reach the centre, you notice several buildings dressed in bright flower decorations. Some people call it the most colourful town on earth.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 아구다 마을은 알록달록한 우산으로 뒤덮인 거리로 유명합니다. 마을 중앙에 닿기도 전에 여러 건물의 앞을 화려한 꽃 장식이 꾸민 것을 보게 됩니다. 세계에서 가장 색채로운 마을이라는 말을 듣기도 합니다.
items.title_en: Is Agueda the most colourful town in the world?
items.title_ko: 아구다, 세계에서 가장 색채로운 마을일까
items.title_original: Is this the most colourful city in the world?

items.raw_excerpt: Seven years ago, Ah Nee Nwe had barely heard of the AFL. Today, the teenager is a grand final winner eyeing a place in history.
items.summary_en: Seven years ago, Ah Nee Nwe had barely heard of Australian rules football. Now the teenager from Nhill, Victoria, has won a junior premiership and hopes to be the first Karen player in the AFL.

items.summary_en: Fendi showed a lighter body shape at its Milan show. Marni mixed its look with a younger generation style. Jil Sander made its clean minimal style feel softer. The shows were part of Milan Fashion Week.

Bei der Street Parade 2025 bringt sie ihren unverkennbaren Sound an den Zürichsee und verwandelt die Straßen in einen brodelnden Open-Air-Rave.

items.summary_en: Actress Delvene Delaney visited Kakadu 40 years ago while making the film Crocodile Dundee. She has now come back to the park to remember that time. Her late husband John Cornell helped write and produce the film.

items.raw_excerpt: Contemplaba una conexión entre Lo Errázuriz y Alameda, pero eso se aplazará luego que su licitación terminara sin adjudicación. "Hubo sucesivos Gobiernos que tomaron un compromiso, que era que el tren iba a llegar desde Melipilla hasta el terminal", criticó el alcalde de Maipú, Tomás Vodanovic.
items.summary_en: Officials had planned to connect the Lo Errázuriz and Alameda sections, but the project was delayed after bidding ended without an award. The mayor of Maipú criticized EFE for postponing work on the underground section of the Santiago–Melipilla train, saying the project had been promised for years.

items.title_en: Santiago–Melipilla train project delayed as officials postpone underground section
